name: LED strip in aluminium channel
description: Slim LED strip (~1.8 x 1.1 cm aluminium channel with a milky diffuser) for under shelves. Origin = top-back-centre, so position y = the shelf's underside. Glows and lights downwards when the room light is on (evening).

source.notes: Typical surface-mount LED profile (e.g. 17 x 7 mm). Power from the room's ceiling light point via a junction box, so the wall switch turns it on.

axis.description: x | z — direction the strip runs (item space)
